summary: Fetches built-in, custom, and sequence parameter values from any OP type into CHOP channels.
key_concepts: Parameter CHOP gets parameter values, including custom parameters, from all OP types.
It replaces the old Fetch CHOP and should be used for OP parameter values rather than CHOP output channels.
Operators, sequences, pargroups, and parameter names all support pattern matching and NOT selections with ^.
Fetch switches between normal parameter fetching and sequence fetching; sequences can create multisample channels by block index.
Name Format controls whether channel names are parameter-only, OP+parameter, or full path names for multi-export workflows.
Use node.par.Customname expressions for one-off reads and Parameter Execute DAT for parameter-change events.

common_gotchas: Parameter CHOP replaces the old Fetch CHOP.
Operators, Sequences, ParGroups, and Parameter fields support pattern matching and NOT selections with ^.
When multiple sequence blocks are selected, the channel can become multisample; sequences with shorter block lengths use HOLD behavior.
Name Format matters for export workflows; full-path names are safer for multi-export but noisier for general control.
For one-off parameter access in expressions, node.par.Customname may be simpler; for event reactions, use Parameter Execute DAT.
Use Select CHOP to retrieve channels from CHOP outputs; Parameter CHOP is for OP parameter values.
